title: robots.txt exists and parses
question: Can an agent fetch /robots.txt and parse it?
method: GET /robots.txt. Pass on a 200 text response that parses under RFC 9309; warn on 404 (everything allowed by default, but intent is unstated); fail on 5xx, a challenge page or unparseable content.

title: Sitemap declared and reachable
question: Is there a sitemap an agent can fetch?
method: Collect Sitemap: lines from robots.txt, then try /sitemap.xml, /sitemap_index.xml and /wp-sitemap.xml. Pass when one returns parseable XML with at least one URL or child sitemap.

title: Product URLs in sitemap
question: Does the sitemap list product pages?
method: Pass when the sitemap index contains a product sitemap (WooCommerce: product-sitemap.xml or wp-sitemap-posts-product-*.xml) or the URL set contains URLs matching product path patterns.

title: Link response headers
question: Does the homepage advertise agent-facing resources in Link headers?
method: Read the Link header on the homepage response. Pass when it carries rel="alternate" type="text/markdown", rel="api-catalog", rel="llms-txt" or an MCP relation; warn when only unrelated links exist; fail when absent.

title: llms.txt present and well-formed
question: Is there an /llms.txt an agent can read?
method: GET /llms.txt. Pass on a Markdown document with an H1, an optional blockquote summary and at least one link section, per llmstxt.org; warn when present but malformed.

title: llms.txt links to catalog
question: Does llms.txt point an agent at the catalog as data?
method: Pass when at least one link in llms.txt targets a product feed, the Store API, a sitemap of products or a product index page.
